title: Flask Basics
intro: Flask interview questions for freshers are about understanding the micro-framework philosophy — Flask gives you the minimum, and you build everything else. This page covers the Flask hello-world application (the five lines every interviewer asks you to explain), route definition with @app.route and URL variable rules (path parameters vs query strings), the request object (request.args for query params, request.json for request body, request.method), returning JSON responses with jsonify(), Flask's Blueprints as the way to split a growing app into logical modules, error handlers with @app.errorhandler, and the Flask vs Django comparison that every fresher interviewer asks: Flask is a micro-framework (routing + request handling, you add the rest), Django is a batteries-included framework (ORM, admin, auth, template engine all built in). Every code example is a complete runnable Flask application, not a snippet missing its imports.
